title: Network-signed Trust Task response verification

subject.scope: successful Trust Task answers and refusals read by network clients

proposition: A consuming network client must not accept an unverified positive Trust Task answer as authoritative network output.

lifecycle.reason: Shadow pilot; no transfer or closure of the original assessment issue.

assessment.basis: Upstream source indicates strengthened verification, but no attributable RAHP execution/result has been imported; registry assessment determination is not_assessed. Operational consuming-path evidence remains outstanding.

sources.claim: Upstream source-level PR and reported tests only; no RAHP execution or independent consumer-path qualification.

residuals.question: Are forged, altered, wrong-purpose or unresolved positive network responses rejected along the actual consumer path without authoritative effects?
Are unsigned refusals handled as non-authorizing failures, and does downstream deployment preserve verification and version compatibility?

reassessment.trigger: Source-pinned executable network-consumer evidence or a material revision affecting issuer/purpose verification and refusal semantics.
